tagline.en_US: Manyfold  is an open source, self-hosted web application for managing a collection of 3D models, particularly focused on 3D printing.

description.en_US: Manyfold is a self-hosted web application designed for managing collections of 3D models. It focuses on organizing, tracking, and cataloging digital assets specifically for 3D printing workflows.
